meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文档,把目录结构、常用命令与编码约定写清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常接手陌生代码库,想让 AI 助手一进项目就摸清结构。
copy.tagline_en: Write layered AGENTS.md so AI assistants learn a repo's structure and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often pick up unfamiliar repos and want AI to know them fast.

howto.what: 为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:扫描仓库的结构、命令和约定,按复杂度评分决定在根目录和哪些子目录写文件,最后问你是本地保留还是走 PR 提交。
howto.when: 当某个仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录成供 agent 使用的文档时触发;在项目里输入 /init-deep 调用,可加 --create-new、--max-depth=N 等参数。

say.note: 在当前仓库生成 AGENTS.md 知识库
先读已有 AGENTS.md,再全删重新生成
把生成的目录深度限制在 2 层

howto.what_en: Generates a layered AGENTS.md knowledge base: scans a repo's structure, commands and conventions, scores directories by complexity, writes root and subdirectory files, then asks whether to keep them local or land them via PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents; invoke /init-deep in the project, optionally with --create-new or --max-depth=N.

say_en.note: Builds the AGENTS.md knowledge base for this repo
Reads existing AGENTS.md, deletes all, regenerates
Limits generated directory depth to 2 levels
